Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [Measures].[FirstChild] AS [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.FirstChild.UniqueName MEMBER [Measures].[LastChild] AS [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.LastChild.UniqueName MEMBER [Measures].[PrevMember] AS [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.PrevMember.UniqueName MEMBER [Measures].[NextMember] AS [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.NextMember.UniqueName MEMBER [Measures].[Siblings] AS [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.Siblings.Count MEMBER [Measures].[UnderDiagnoses] AS Intersect({[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES]}, Ascendants([ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.Parent)).Count SELECT {[Measures].[FirstChild], [Measures].[LastChild], [Measures].[PrevMember], [Measures].[NextMember], [Measures].[Siblings], [Measures].[UnderDiagnoses]} ON 0, {[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY].[UPPER_RESPIRATORY_INFECTIONS], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY].[UPPER_RESPIRATORY_INFECTIONS].[J06], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[CIRCULATORY]} ON 1 FROM [ZCLVISIT]
